name: TeachIT Official Addons Catalog
description: Official educational computer-science games catalogue for the TeachIT offline launcher.

games.name: Binary Switch Circuit
games.shortDescription: Toggle bit switches to master powers of two and decimal numeral conversion.
games.description: Master binary numerals, powers of two, and bitwise representation by toggling logic switches to match target decimal values.
learningObjectives: Understand binary number representation and bit states (0 and 1)
Calculate values using powers of two (128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1)
Convert between decimal integers and binary byte sequences
instructions: Review the target decimal number displayed at the top.
Click the bit switches to toggle them between 0 and 1.
The total sum of all active powers of two must match the target number.
Click Next Challenge to advance when the sum is correct.
games.author: TeachIT Curriculum Lab
games.releaseNotes: Initial release of Binary Switch Circuit for TeachIT.

games.name: Falling Letter
games.shortDescription: Catch falling letters with quick keystrokes before they hit the ground.
games.description: Practise keyboard recognition and typing speed by catching falling letters before they hit the ground.
learningObjectives: Identify and locate keyboard keys rapidly
Improve typing speed and hand-eye coordination
Reinforce home-row and alphabet muscle memory
instructions: Watch letters as they fall from the top of the screen.
Press the corresponding letter on your keyboard before it hits the ground.
Each correct letter earns +10 points; missed letters lose 5 points.
Complete the 60-second round before running out of hearts!
games.author: TeachIT Curriculum Lab
games.releaseNotes: Initial release of Falling Letter for TeachIT.

games.name: Mouse Master
games.shortDescription: Pratique le contrôle du curseur et la précision du clic à travers des défis.
games.description: Apprends à utiliser la souris grâce à des défis interactifs.
learningObjectives: Développer la motricité fine et la précision du pointeur de souris
Maîtriser le simple clic, le double-clic et le clic droit
Pratiquer le glisser-déposer d'objets à l'écran
instructions: Atelier 1 & 2 : déplace le curseur et clique sur les cibles mobiles.
Atelier 3 : effectue un double-clic rapide pour ouvrir les éléments.
Atelier 4 : glisse et dépose les objets vers leur zone de destination.
Atelier 5 : utilise le clic droit pour faire apparaître les menus contextuels.

controls.action: Déplacer les fichiers vers la corbeille

games.author: TeachIT Curriculum Lab
games.releaseNotes: Initial release of Mouse Master for TeachIT.

games.name: Sorting Algorithm Arena
games.shortDescription: Compare and analyze sorting algorithms step-by-step in an interactive visual arena.
games.description: Visualize and compare time complexity, item swaps, and sorting mechanics between Bubble Sort and Selection Sort.
learningObjectives: Visualize how sorting algorithms organize unsorted data arrays
Compare time and swap efficiency between Bubble Sort and Selection Sort
Analyze comparisons, data exchanges, and sorted sub-arrays step-by-step
instructions: Select an algorithm (Bubble Sort or Selection Sort) from the controls.
Click 'Step' to step through one comparison and swap at a time.
Observe which bars are highlighted: yellow for comparison, green for sorted.
Use 'Auto Run' to see the sorting animation execute continuously.

controls.action: Shuffle bars to generate a new array

games.author: TeachIT Algorithms Group
games.releaseNotes: Initial release of Sorting Algorithm Arena for TeachIT.
